sections.title: Configuring cost groups
sections.content:
## Steps

### Step 1

Go to the Cost groups menu and click the create button.

![](/uploads/9126ce2c73d7445af7fa307e.png)

### Step 2

Enter the information:

- Cost group: enter the name of the cost group.

- Parent category: select the parent group, if any.

![](/uploads/a56c56a2153e3ec60b0b6757.png)

sections.title: Configuring cost types
sections.content:
## Steps

### Step 1

Go to the **Cost types** menu and click the create button.

![](/uploads/9126ce2c73d7445af7fa307e.png)

### Step 2

Enter the basic information:

- Cost type: enter the name of the cost.

- Cost group: select the cost group.

- Internal code: enter the cost code.

- Tax: select the VAT type. When this cost type is recorded, the system calculates the default tax amount from the tax type configured here.

![](/uploads/9f02c3285a9429eb83cdca97.png)

### Step 3

Open the [Cost configuration] tab to add some more advanced settings:

- Needs approval: tick this if a dispatcher has to approve the cost after a driver creates it.

- Driver required: tick this to manage the cost type per driver. When a cost is created, the system requires the driver who incurred it.

- Dispatch order required: tick this to manage the cost type per dispatch order. When a cost is created, the system requires the dispatch order it belongs to.

- Vehicle required: tick this to manage the cost type per vehicle. When a cost is created, the system requires the vehicle that incurred it.

- Invoice or document required: tick this if an invoice or document must be attached to the cost.

- Location required: tick this to manage the cost type per location. When a cost is created, the system requires the location where it was incurred.

- Show in the mobile app: tick this if you want the cost type to appear in the Mobile App, so drivers can create it. If you leave it unticked, only dispatchers can create this type of cost.

- Note for the driver: this note appears in the driver mobile app when the driver records this type of cost.

![](/uploads/c62c090821818ca0ed2488fb.png)

sections.content:

sections.title: Creating a cost (for dispatchers)
sections.content:
## Note

The driver mobile app already lets drivers record their additional costs and upload the invoices and documents. Use this function when a dispatcher needs to create the cost themselves.

## Steps

### Step 1

Go to the **All costs** menu and click the create button.

### Step 2

Enter the information:

- Cost date: select the date the cost was incurred.

- Cost type: select the type of cost.

- Amount: enter the amount, including tax.

- Tax: select the tax type, if any.

- Description: enter a description of the cost, if any.

- Invoice / Document: attach the invoice or document.

- Driver: select the driver.

- Dispatch order: select the dispatch order the cost belongs to, if required.

- Vehicle: select the vehicle that incurred the cost, if required.

- Location: select the location where the cost was incurred, if required.

![](/uploads/f321dc58d3eb837ead19184a.png)

- Some additional information:

  - Supplier: select the service supplier, if that supplier already exists in the system.

  - Invoice number: enter the invoice number.

  - Serial number: enter the invoice serial number.

  - Tax code: enter the tax code of the service supplier.

![](/uploads/3e11a24c03e8efcd5a929aed.png)

### Step 3

Click the save button to finish creating the cost record. A newly created record is in the **NEW** state.

![](/uploads/e1f0c0a1685ea7cd34b5839f.png)

### Step 4

Click CONFIRM to confirm the cost record.

- If the cost type is configured to need approval, the record moves to **WAITING FOR APPROVAL** after you confirm it.

- If the cost type is not configured to need approval, the record moves straight to **APPROVED** after you confirm it.

![](/uploads/fee2113d07ea59af789b7ff2.png)

sections.title: Approving a cost
sections.content:
## Steps

### Step 1

Open a cost record in the **WAITING FOR APPROVAL** state and click **APPROVE**.

![](/uploads/11d69a3588435c3079747c2e.png)

The cost record moves to the **APPROVED** state.

![](/uploads/da98c0f3f120064fa93c3af8.png)

You can also approve several cost records at once: on the cost list, select the records you want to approve and click APPROVE as shown below.

![](/uploads/8cb65a170f35e966aef2a48a.png)

sections.title: Rejecting a cost
sections.content:
## Steps

### Step 1

Open a cost record in the **WAITING FOR APPROVAL** state and click **REJECT**.

![](/uploads/5517d5aeabbf50ef1012f810.png)

The cost record moves to the **REJECTED** state.

![](/uploads/21f27be6434cada6a73cedaa.png)

sections.title: Marking the payment or reimbursement status
sections.content:
## Payment and reimbursement statuses

There are four payment and reimbursement statuses:

- Not processed: the payment or reimbursement to the driver has not been processed.

- In progress: the payment or reimbursement to the driver is being processed.

- Paid in full: the driver has been paid or reimbursed the full amount.

- Partially paid: the driver has been paid or reimbursed part of the amount.

## Marking In progress

On an **APPROVED** cost record, click **MOVE TO IN PROGRESS**.

![](/uploads/5ee1e74a9f65368de9957fa0.png)

![](/uploads/b3b39003ca629b5fc8b2f89e.png)

## Marking Paid in full

On an **APPROVED** cost record, click **MOVE TO PAID IN FULL**.

![](/uploads/ea19b14b202c8a4940e2b8b6.png)

![](/uploads/2522a7023e51ce406f2dc988.png)

## Marking Partially paid

On an **APPROVED** cost record, enter the amount already paid and click save. The system moves the record to the **PARTIALLY PAID** status automatically.

![](/uploads/2a97f9de993b79267b0d60b9.png)

![](/uploads/765a16a3a9ce3e40758d6971.png)
